title: Cartwise Rewards Membership Terms — Joining, Activation and Leaving
content:
Enrollment in Cartwise Rewards is free and starts at Cartwise Rewards Member.

## Clauses

1. **Joining.** Enrollment is free and starts at Cartwise Rewards Member, whatever the customer has spent before joining.
2. **Activation.** The account activates when the customer's first order after enrollment closes. Until then the account is enrolled but not active; activation is the point at which points start to post.
3. **Leaving.** A customer may leave at any time. Points lapse on closure where the tier's closure setting says that points lapse when the account closes.
4. **Closure for inactivity.** An account with no order for the tier's inactivity period — the number of months without any order after which an account is closed — is closed, and the reason recorded for the closure is inactivity.

## Account stages

| Stage | How the account reaches it |
|---|---|
| Enrolled | The customer joins Cartwise Rewards; the account opens at Cartwise Rewards Member |
| Active | The system activates the account when the first qualifying order completes, and points start to post |
| Closed, by the customer, from enrolled | The customer leaves the program before any qualifying order |
| Closed, by the customer, from active | The customer leaves the program |
| Closed for inactivity | The account has had no order for the tier's inactivity period; the closure reason is inactivity |

## Clause by clause: condition and result

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| A customer joins | No fee is charged; the tier is Cartwise Rewards Member |
| The customer's first order after enrollment closes | The account becomes active |
| The customer asks to leave | The account closes; points lapse where the tier's closure setting says they do |
| The account has had no order for the tier's inactivity period | The account is closed with the reason inactivity |

## Hypothetical cases

- A customer enrolls and places an order that is still being shopped (hypothetical). The order has not closed, so the account is still enrolled. When that order closes, the account activates.
- A hypothetical account on a tier whose inactivity period is 24 months has had no order for 30 months: it has passed the period and is closed with the reason inactivity. A hypothetical account on the same tier whose last order was 20 months ago has not reached the period.
- A customer who has never had a qualifying order leaves the program (hypothetical). The account goes from enrolled to closed.

## Basis Q&A

**Does a customer start at a higher tier because of past spend?** No. Every enrollment starts at Cartwise Rewards Member.

**What counts toward inactivity?** Orders: the clause measures months with no order on the account.

**What happens to the balance when the customer leaves?** The account closes, and its points lapse where the tier's closure setting says points lapse when the account closes.
